releaseNotes: Smart Search OCR startup fix: the ML Kit text recognizer is now created safely on Android's main thread before indexing enters its worker thread. OCR-engine initialization and shutdown are guarded so an internal Android/ML Kit null-reference error cannot crash the first batch or expose an obfuscated system message. Index progress now refreshes from the persisted database after every 20-file batch instead of assuming a full batch completed. If the OCR engine becomes unavailable, indexing pauses safely without marking pending files complete, and Resume retries them. Existing Smart Search Index Settings, persistent checkpoints, document-image filtering, PDF/Screenshot/scan priority, voice search and opening motion are preserved.
